en.headline: Police set citywide restricted flying zone for Interpol General Assembly
en.dek: From 30 November to 3 December, drones, kites, balloons and light aircraft will be banned across Hong Kong, with marine and road restrictions near the Wan Chai venue.
body: The Hong Kong Police Force announced on Monday that a territory-wide temporary Restricted Flying Zone will be in force from 12.01am on 30 November until 5pm on 3 December during the 94th Interpol General Assembly.

Chief Superintendent Wong Chi-wing of the Operations Bureau said the zone will prohibit flights of helicopters and light aircraft except those by the Government Flying Service, as well as small unmanned aircraft without special permission, paragliding, airships, kites and mass releases of balloons. Commercial civil aviation will not be affected.

A temporary marine restricted area will cover part of Victoria Harbour off the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre in Wan Chai, and roads around the venue including Golden Bauhinia Square will be closed. Water taxis between Tsim Sha Tsui, Central and Wan Chai will not stop in Wan Chai.

The assembly, the first hosted by Hong Kong, is expected to draw more than 1,000 delegates from 196 member countries. Police said the measures are based on risk assessment and aim to minimise disruption to daily life.

zh.headline: 警方就國際刑警大會設全港臨時限制飛行區
zh.dek: 11月30日至12月3日期間，全港禁飛無人機、風箍及輕型飛機等，灣仔會展附近設海陸管制。
body: 香港警務處周一宣布，為配合第94屆國際刑警組織全體大會，將由11月30日凌晨0時01分至12月3日下午5時，在全港範圍設立臨時限制飛行區。
行動部總警司王智榮表示，期間除政府飛行服務隊外，禁止直升機及小型飛機飛行；未經特別許可的小型無人機、滑翔傘、飛艇、風箍及大量放飛氣球亦受管制，民航機服務不受影響。
灣仔香港會議展覽中心對開維港部分水域將設臨時海上限制區，會場周邊道路包括金紫荊廣場將封閉。往來尖沙咀、中環及灣仔的水上的士將不停泊灣仔。
大會屬香港首次主辦，預計超過1000名來自196個成員國的代表出席。警方指措施基於風險評估，並盡量減少對市民日常出行的影響。
